newsitem.title: INDIA: India BPCL 1st hlf sales up at 7.4 mln t.
newsitem.headline: India BPCL 1st hlf sales up at 7.4 mln t.

text.p: India's state-run Bharat Petroleum Corporation Ltd said its sales during April to September 1996 rose to 7.4 million tonnes compared with 6.95 million tonnes in the year-ago period.
"During the same period, the refinery achieved a throughput of 4.07 million tonnes compared to 3.48 million tonnes," it said in a statement on Thursday.

"Other income (during the first half) includes dividend of 16.13 million rupees, representing earnings for the full accounting year from investments made in Units 1964 scheme of the Unit Trust of India (corresponding figure for previous year is 236.94 million rupees)," it said.
The work on the Bombay-Manmad pipeline was progressing as per schedule and is expected to be commissioned by April 1998, it said.

At a board meeting in New Delhi late on Wednesday, the company said its earnings per share (annualised) rose to 27.58 rupees in 1996/97 (April-March) compared with 25.71 rupees in the year ago period.
